blind.description: An ornate classical armchair featuring a carved reddish-brown polished wood or bronze frame and plush red velvet or leather upholstery. The backrest has an ornate carved crest, curved padded center, rolled armrests decorated with studs along the front facings, a thick cushioned seat, carved front skirt with stud accents, and four decorative cabriole legs. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with no holes, shards, or floating parts.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a square-ish red seat bordered on the left and right by thick rounded armrests and on the upper edge by the carved horizontal crest of the backrest.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about half as wide as the figure is tall.
